save.conflict: Another tab has updated this game. Download a copy of this tab before reloading.
network.localCopy: Your existing stall stays on this device. History transfer is not available yet. Starting on the server creates separate progress without importing or deleting this save.
network.otherTab: This stall is open in another tab. Close that tab and retry.
network.invalidSession: Your session expired. Unacknowledged actions remain on this device.
network.conflict: Account state does not match. Queued actions are retained and sending is paused to protect your progress.
network.storage: Unable to save the action queue. Check storage permissions and available space, then retry.
network.unavailable: Cannot connect to the server. Existing saved progress is preserved.
network.serverSaved: Progress is saved on the server. Queued actions remain on this device until acknowledged.
error.storage: Could not save the action. Progress is unchanged.
error.bufferFull: The queue is full. Reconnect to send the saved actions.
admin.title: Stall administration
admin.subtitle: Configuration · Approvals · History
admin.access: Use an account with administrator access.
admin.unavailable: Admin sign-in is not configured. A Google Client ID and server account directory are required.
admin.pin: Open shifts keep their configuration. New shifts use the published activation schedule.
admin.storage: Draft could not be saved. Export JSON to keep your work; submission requires a saved draft.
admin.corrupt: Previous draft cannot be read. Download a copy before discarding.
admin.discardConfirm: Discard the draft saved in this tab?
admin.otherOwner: This draft belongs to another account. Sign in as its author to continue.
admin.phase.note: Status is for this version in its registry scope at the last read. Player overrides and existing shift pins still apply. Refresh to read the latest status.
admin.compare.title: Compare two versions
admin.compare.note: Enter two stored version IDs, including drafts. Compare each snapshot and its own k-scaled values; this is not a player's effective configuration.
admin.pending: Submission is unresolved. Keep this payload unchanged and retry the same request.
admin.author: Author
admin.dual: Tier A changes require approval by a different Super Admin.
admin.readonly: This account can only view configuration.
admin.error.network: Network failure or timeout. Your draft is retained; retry to resolve the result.
admin.error.session: The admin session expired or changed account. Sign in again to continue.
admin.error.factor: Code is invalid, expired or already used. Enter a fresh Authenticator code.
admin.error.limit: Action limit reached. Wait before retrying.
admin.error.forbidden: This account cannot perform this change.
admin.error.stale: The base version is stale. Export your draft, open the latest version and review your changes again.
admin.error.activation: Activation conflicts with policy or an existing schedule. Choose a later activation.
admin.error.config: Invalid configuration. Check values and related constraints.
admin.error.google: Google authentication failed. Try signing in again.
admin.error.large: File or request is too large. Limit: 512 KiB.
admin.error.generic: Action did not complete. Refresh to check its status before retrying.
admin.scope.title: Configuration scope
admin.scope.global: Applies to every new opening except keys covered by overrides.
admin.scope.explicit: The explicit ID audience is saved with the proposal; no automatic Life Path classification.
admin.scope.idsOnly: Only IDs are listed to select the intended save.
admin.impact.title: Resolved configuration impact
admin.impact.factual: Compares existing saves at planned activation. Live shifts stay pinned; this is not a seven-day economic forecast.
admin.support.title: Support requests
admin.support.idempotency: Reuse the case key on retries to recover the same ticket. A ticket grants no coins or points.
admin.error.scopeMissing: No published scope with that name exists.
admin.error.scope: Check the scope name, player IDs and priority.
admin.error.expiry: Expiry must follow activation. Campaign and player overrides require expiry.
admin.error.conflict: Conflicting overrides share a priority; review their keys.
admin.error.ticket: The ticket belongs to another player or has already been used.
admin.error.keyConflict: This request key was used with different content.
admin.error.staleImpact: Impact has changed. Review the refreshed preview and confirm again.
admin.forecast.title: Seven-day economy scenario
admin.forecast.assumptions: Simulates existing players continuously active from a server snapshot. No new-player or real-activity assumptions; open shifts retain their configuration. This report is bound to its snapshot time; rerun after configuration changes.
admin.forecast.running: Simulating on a private copy. Gameplay remains available.
admin.forecast.empty: No existing saves in this audience to project.
admin.forecast.complete: All existing audience saves were simulated.
admin.forecast.vnd: VND revenue unavailable: no observed donation data. In-game coins are not real-money revenue.
admin.error.staleForecast: Configuration changed during simulation. Refresh the proposal and rerun the scenario.
entry.title: Choose your language and enter the stall

entry.loadError: The stall could not be loaded. Please retry to continue.
account.title: Account
account.free: Play for free, without signing in.
account.linked: Your progress is saved to your Google account.
guest.browserOnly: Browser edition: progress is saved only here. Clearing site data or changing browsers will not carry this save over. Export a backup in Settings. Sign-in, sync and online rankings are not available yet.
account.localCopy: This progress is saved on your device. Linking this save is not available yet; you can still export a backup in Settings.
account.success: Signed in. Continue with your account progress.
account.unavailable: Google sign-in is not available yet. You can close this menu and keep playing.
account.scriptError: The Google button could not load. Check your connection or try again.
account.verifyError: This sign-in attempt is no longer valid. Try again to start a new one.
account.networkError: Your account could not be confirmed. Progress is preserved; check your connection and try again.
error.accountBusy: Your account is being confirmed. Please wait a moment.
account.signIn: Sign up / Sign in with Google
account.guestCopy: Your stall progress stays on this device when you close and reopen the game. Play history, achievements, ranking and restore on another device require a Google account.
account.savedCopy: Save progress and achievements and restore them on another device. Existing accounts continue their saved progress.
account.recoveryCopy: Use the account you played with to restore progress and pending actions.
account.wrongAccount: This Google account does not match the pending progress. Choose the account you played with.
onboarding.login.firstShift: First shift finished! A Google account adds history, achievements and ranking.
onboarding.login.leaderboard: Sign in to take your place on the leaderboard.
onboarding.login.leave: Use a Google account for play history, achievements and ranking.
admin.review.title: Player history review and flags
admin.review.note: Inspect the history validated at save import. Approval allows competitive credit only; it does not add coins or change the shift.
admin.review.noImport: This player has no imported local history.
admin.review.readOnly: Support accounts can inspect history only.
admin.review.uncertain: Result not confirmed. Retry the exact saved request below.
admin.review.conflict: This data cannot be used. Inspect the player and history again before deciding.
admin.review.storage: The recovery request could not be saved. No action was sent.
admin.review.failed: No result received. Check the connection and retry.
admin.review.corrupt: The previous request cannot be read. Download a copy and check the decision audit before clearing it.
admin.review.discardConfirm: Have you saved a copy and checked the decision audit? Clear the damaged request in this tab?
rank.title: Leaderboard
rank.offline: Could not load the latest board. The saved preview may be out of date.
rank.accountChanged: Your account session changed. Close the board and reconnect your account.
rank.empty: No one in this tier yet.
rank.googleRequired: Sign in with Google to join the leaderboard.
rank.insufficientShifts: Not enough confirmed shifts in this season to rank yet.
rank.flagged: This account is under review and temporarily hidden from the board.
rank.review.pending: Local history is awaiting review. Only earnings and shifts after sign-in count while it is pending.
rank.review.rejected: Local history was not accepted for ranking. Your game progress is preserved.
admin.emergency.title: Emergency hotfix · Tier A/B
admin.emergency.note: Apply immediately from the active configuration. Replace pending schedules in this scope and open a 24-hour review ticket.
admin.emergency.none: No pending schedules will be superseded.
admin.error.emergencyTier: Emergency publication allows only Tier A/B. Submit Tier C keys through a normal proposal.
account.devOnly: Local testing mode. This is not a real Google sign-in.

metrics.title: Shift metrics
metrics.unavailable: This legacy shift lacks enough data for whole-shift metrics.
metrics.basis: With snacks {moi}/{served} rounds · Flat {stale}/{beer} beers served · Arrivals {arrived} · Queue full {rejected}.
metrics.note: Value per round includes dish payments and tips, excluding bonuses and deliveries. k measures value, not serving speed. Rates without a sample show —; displayed values are rounded and backups retain exact values.
